2609.23600.title: PETR: Prompt Ensembling with Training-free Routing for Vision-Language Models
2609.23600.paper_summary: Prompt learning efficiently adapts vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks, but gains on seen classes often come at the expense of generalization to unseen classes. To address this limitation, we propose prompt ensembling with training-free routing (PETR), whose key innovation is a carefully designed dual-prompt architecture: two complementary prompts are learned from different data and objectives to emphasize seen class discrimination and unseen-class generalization, respectively. During training, both prompts are fine-tuned using a shared frozen CLIP backbone, and statistical information is collected from the training set logits. At inference time, we determine the similarity of each test sample to seen data, and route the sample to the most appropriate prompt branch. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first prompt tuning framework that performs training-free adaptive routing based on statistical similarity. This design provides an interpretable routing signal and avoids common MoE-style routing pathologies, such as router training instability and load imbalance. Extensive experiments on 11 benchmark datasets demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms previous methods on both seen and unseen classes, achieving new state-of-the-art results.
2609.23600.paper_summary_zh: 提示學習有效地將視覺-語言模型（VLMs）適應於下游任務，但對於已見類別的增益往往以未見類別的泛化為代價。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了無需訓練的路由提示集成（PETR），其關鍵創新是一種精心設計的雙提示架構：從不同數據和目標中學習的兩個互補提示，分別強調已見類別的區分和未見類別的泛化。在訓練過程中，兩個提示都使用共享的凍結CLIP骨幹進行微調，並從訓練集的logits中收集統計信息。在推理時，我們確定每個測試樣本與已見數據的相似性，並將樣本路由到最合適的提示分支。據我們所知，這是第一個基於統計相似性進行無需訓練的自適應路由的提示調整框架。這一設計提供了可解釋的路由信號，並避免了常見的MoE風格路由病態，如路由器訓練不穩定和負載不平衡。在11個基準數據集上的大量實驗表明，我們的框架在已見和未見類別上始終超越先前的方法，實現了新的最先進結果。
